sources.title: AOSP RuntimeInit default HTTP agent
sources.scope: Default http.agent appends Build.MODEL in release builds; current source is grammar evidence, not proof every OEM/version uses the unmodified default. Property is not the WebView JS user agent.

sources.title: Chrome user-agent reduction: Android model and version
sources.scope: Model may be omitted/reduced. Restrict parsing to explicit unambiguous model-before-Build tokens; no recovery of missing model.

sources.title: Khronos WEBGL_debug_renderer_info
sources.scope: Renderer identifies aspects of underlying driver; optional exposure/privacy and alternative rendering paths prevent universal SoC mapping. Literal-family normalization is project logic.

sources.title: W3C Device Memory API draft
sources.scope: Approximate physical memory with implementation-defined bounds, which may change; no universal Native-kernel RAM equality or fixed difference follows.

sources.title: Android ActivityManager.MemoryInfo
sources.scope: totalMem is kernel-accessible memory excluding fixed below-kernel allocations; not necessarily advertised physical capacity.

sources.title: HTML Navigator platform and plugin compatibility surfaces
sources.scope: Legacy navigator exposure is not independently verified hardware architecture or a general installed-plugin inventory.
